chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Malik ibn Ashyam, from one of his men, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'Marry a brunette, of large eyes, of a medium stature, so if you dislike her, then her dowry would be upon me (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.عَجْزَاءَ: Of medium stature (specifically referring to the hips/buttocks in this context)

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended physical characteristics for a wife according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises men to marry women who are brunette, have large eyes, and are of medium stature, noting that if the husband dislikes her, he is entitled to a dowry from the Imam. This hadith highlights specific physical attributes preferred in marriage within Shia tradition and offers a unique guarantee regarding dowry.
